info.name: MyDash Integration Suite
info.description:
Newman/Postman collection covering every public OCS route declared in `appinfo/routes.php` (131 routes). Each request asserts the documented happy-path status + payload shape, and at least one error envelope assertion is exercised per route family (401 unauthenticated, 403 admin-gated, 400 validation, 404 not-found). The collection seeds + tears down its own fixture dashboard, tile, placement, comment, rule, role, metadata-field and template so it never pollutes pre-existing data.

Run:
  npx newman run tests/integration/mydash.postman_collection.json --environment tests/integration/local.env.json

The Nextcloud test instance MUST be reachable on `{{baseUrl}}` and the `{{adminUser}}` account MUST be an actual NC admin. Endpoints that require admin gating are flagged with the `admin-only` Postman folder; the collection skips them as soft-fails when the configured account is not admin (status assertion accepts 200/403).
